address-input role: Web Components follows the contract's <input>; Svelte renders a <div role="group">.
citation aria-label: Not ported: <cite> has no role that takes a name. Svelte is the outlier.
code aria-label: Not ported: <code> has no role that takes a name. Svelte is the outlier.
code-block role: role="region" when labelled, so its focusable scroll area has a name; Svelte keys this on aria-label, which the sweep does not pass.
editable aria-label: Set on the inner display element, not the host the sweep reads.
editable role: Set on the inner display element, not the host the sweep reads.
floating-panel aria-label: Set only while open, in the sweep's closed state. Svelte keeps it on when closed.
floating-panel role: Set only while open, in the sweep's closed state. Svelte keeps it on when closed.
go-to-next-section aria-label: Here `label` is the link's visible text, so its name comes from content; a duplicate aria-label would add nothing.
go-to-previous-section aria-label: Here `label` is the link's visible text, so its name comes from content; a duplicate aria-label would add nothing.
go-to-top aria-label: Here `label` is the link's visible text, so its name comes from content; a duplicate aria-label would add nothing.
hover-card aria-label: Set only while open, in the sweep's closed state. Svelte keeps it on when closed.
hover-card role: Set only while open, in the sweep's closed state. Svelte keeps it on when closed.
kbd aria-label: Not ported: <kbd> has no role that takes a name. Svelte is the outlier.
red-amber-green-picker role: A deliberate structural difference: a radiogroup, where Svelte renders a <select>.
red-orange-yellow-green-blue-picker role: A deliberate structural difference: a radiogroup, where Svelte renders a <select>.
slider role: The custom element is itself the slider, so it carries the role an <input type="range"> has natively.
timeout-dialog aria-label: Named by its visible title through aria-labelledby, which is stronger than a duplicate aria-label.
